project_info.title: Passionate chair dance on a neon stage

prompt.main_subject: An adult dancer with long curly brown hair and pink highlights, wearing a white short cropped hoodie, black leather shorts, and black Martin boots, seated on a glossy black vintage chair while performing a confident chair-dance routine.
prompt.composition_elements: The dancer and glossy vintage chair are central on a reflective stage floor. A stage wall of colored circular lights changes color with the rhythm, creating a layered modern-pop performance scene.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Hair light, face fill light, and soft side light create controlled contrast, mottled light and shadow, clear facial detail, and rich picture layers. The atmosphere is trendy, dynamic, and stage-focused.

technical_specs.duration_pacing: Smooth 10-second pacing as stated in the source.
technical_specs.camera: Cinematic camera movement and cutting are requested, but exact shot path is not specified.
technical_specs.audio: Electronic synth music throughout with heavy drum beats; no dialogue or subtitles.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a smooth 10-second vertical 9:16 video with extreme high definition, cinematic camera sense, cinematic image quality, and master-level camera movement and cutting. An adult dancer with long curly brown hair and pink highlights wears a white short cropped hoodie, black leather shorts, and black Martin boots. She sits on a glossy black vintage chair and confidently performs a chair-dance routine. The background is a stage wall composed of colored circular lights that change color with the rhythm, with a reflective stage floor. The overall style is trendy and stage-focused, with the dynamic atmosphere of modern pop music. Use delicate natural expression, hair light, face fill light, soft side light, contrast, mottled light and shadow, rich picture layers, clear facial detail, long eyelashes, and defined makeup with a natural cool-white skin tone. Use electronic synth music throughout with heavy drum beats, no dialogue, and no subtitles. Keep the human body structure natural, movement smooth, and the image stable without flicker.
prompt.negative_prompt: blurry, low resolution, noise, watermark, text, logo, distortion, deformation, disfigured face, stiff movements, camera shake, flicker, disproportionate, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed

omni_video_prompt.SFX: Electronic synth music with heavy drum beats; no additional effects specified.
